# category is per-row here because this file spans subjects.

column9: Sign-in interrupted because multifactor authentication is required and was not completed; expected after MFA or Conditional Access policy changes and from new devices or locations. The user completes MFA or re-registers methods; this code alone is not an outage.

Token issuance was blocked by a Conditional Access policy. Open the sign-in log entry and read its Conditional Access tab to see which policy failed and why; replay the scenario in What If before changing any policy.

Windows MDM enrollment failed because the user has no valid Intune license or falls outside the MDM user scope. Assign the license or fix the automatic-enrollment scope and retry; the error is user-side and not a device defect.

The receiving side refused the message: a restricted recipient or distribution list; an unauthenticated relay attempt; or the sender failing the destination domain's authentication policy. The exact reason is in the full NDR text underneath the code.
